eyebrow: Lesson 15's list of dicts, made real
code:
trips = [
  {"VendorID": "2", "passenger_count": 1, "fare_amount": 14.50},
  {"VendorID": "1", "passenger_count": 3, "fare_amount": 9.75},
]

df = pd.DataFrame(trips)

caption: Rows, columns, an automatic index, real per-column types — all inferred automatically.

eyebrow: The first four things you run on any DataFrame
code:
